title: xylosteon hispidum

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Xylosteon hispidum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which have been reported to aid in the relief of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
